correctness.rationale: Let T be the k 2-labeled rook cells, a covered rows and b covered columns. Every cell outside these rows/columns is forced 1, so weight>=2k+(m-a)(n-b); forced ones cannot neighbor any 2 and thus do not support them. For k<=m-3 weight>2m; k=m-2 equality forces isolated 2s and fails support. For k=m-1, inspect n>=m+2 and n=m,m+1, with support forcing weight>2m except small squares 2x2 and 3x3. For k=m all-zero remaining configuration requires covering all rows (or all columns in square boards) and every occupied column/row having >=2 defender 2s. Row maps with no singleton fibers count F_m(n)=m![u^m](e^u-u)^n. The exceptional boards contribute +9 at 2x2 and +54 at 3x3; totals 13 and 60. Brute independently checked all weight<=2m labelings for boards (2,2),(2,3),(2,5),(3,3),(3,4),(4,4): minima 2m and optimum counts 13,3,5,60,4,80. Source bundled verifier separately checks larger complete defender-map classes. This is a symbolic all m<=n >=2 classification supported, not proved solely by samples.
